notes:
Merged from two passes that agree on all four benchmark checks (kept), the new group (GROUP_009: Service Desk Unified Hub, Service Desk, the stated description, manager USER_068, active), the activation of Leah Lewis (USER_068), the five memberships moving from GROUP_003 to GROUP_009, the removal of the five GROUP_003 rows, and the stay on the three L2 Service Desk (GROUP_004) memberships.
disagreement: the membership check's structure: A one natural-key requirement per member, B one requirement with a count of 5 over user_id IN (the five); kept A's split as the tighter form and because several created rows in one table are found by natural key, not by sequence position, with the benchmark check carried jointly by all five (logged in the first membership).
disagreement: a stay that no user outside the five joins GROUP_009: A writes it, B does not; kept because it is the boundary of the transfer set, which a loose reading of 'all first-contact Service Desk activity' would widen to the L2 members (logged in the requirement).
disagreement: cells of the memberships, the removal and the GROUP_004 stay: A leaves cells empty or repeats both selector columns, B repeats the selector or writes user_id IN (...) as a cell; chose the row key in the selector and the tested column as the cell, with no selector column repeated in cells (the GROUP_004 stay therefore has no cells); no sql changed (logged in each).
Seed facts re-checked at merge: GROUP_003 (L1 Service Desk) has members USER_003, USER_013, USER_015, USER_022, USER_023; GROUP_004 (L2 Service Desk) has USER_031, USER_024, USER_025; USER_068 Leah Lewis is the only Lewis, role manager, active = 0; the acting user USER_039 is an admin (full CRUD), so the policy allows every step; GROUP_008 and MEM_028 are the highest ids; no group named like the new one exists. Nothing in the request deactivates or renames L1 Service Desk, so no stay is written for the group row itself. A manager added as a member of the new group would fail the boundary stay; the request does not ask for it.
revised: the L2 Service Desk stay repeated its selector column group_id in cells; cells emptied, since the selector already fixes it and the sql is unchanged.
revised: two resolution reasons cited a working rule or earlier files instead of the reason; reworded to state the reason itself (natural keys for several created rows; no column repeated between selector and cells).
